title: My Father's Driving Lessons
genre: เรื่องเล่า
text:
When I turned eighteen, I decided (1) how to drive. My father agreed (2) me every Sunday. At first, I was too nervous (3) the car out of the garage. My father kept (4), "Relax. Everyone makes mistakes." He made me (5) slowly around an empty car park for hours. I hated (6) the same thing again and again, but slowly I improved.
One day, he suggested (7) on a real road. I remember (8) the steering wheel so hard that my hands hurt. After a few months, I was good enough (9) the driving test. I passed! Now I'm looking forward to (10) my grandparents on my own.

items.stem: (1) When I turned eighteen, I decided ___ how to drive.
why_wrong: decide ไม่ตามด้วย V-ing

items.stem: (2) My father agreed ___ me every Sunday.
why_wrong: agree ไม่ตามด้วย V-ing

items.stem: (3) At first, I was too nervous ___ the car out of the garage.

items.explanation_th: keep + V-ing = พูดซ้ำ ๆ → "saying"
why_wrong: keep ไม่ตามด้วย to V
keep ไม่ตามด้วย V1

items.stem: (5) He made me ___ slowly around an empty car park for hours.
why_wrong: make sb to V ผิด

items.stem: (6) I hated ___ the same thing again and again, but slowly I improved.
(7) One day, he suggested ___ on a real road.
why_wrong: suggest ไม่ตามด้วย to V

items.stem: (8) I remember ___ the steering wheel so hard that my hands hurt.
items.explanation_th: remember + V-ing = จำได้ว่าเคยทำ (ความทรงจำ) → "holding"
why_wrong: remember to hold = อย่าลืมจับ ความหมายผิด

items.stem: (9) After a few months, I was good enough ___ the driving test.
(10) Now I'm looking forward to ___ my grandparents on my own.
why_wrong: to visit ซ้อนผิด (to ตรงนี้เป็นบุพบท)
